summary: Verstappen arrives in Singapore riding a sprint victory and qualifying pole position, seeking to capitalize on McLaren's troubled Saturday and extend Red Bull's resurgent form against the Ferraris lurking on the front row. George Russell's crash from the sprint lead leaves Mercedes vulnerable in the fight for constructors' points, while Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton circle as genuine threats to Verstappen's dominant pace. A commanding Sunday victory would cement Verstappen's momentum shift and narrow McLaren's championship advantage at a critical juncture of the season.
